visualCharacteristics: Horizontal row of icon tiles (icon + label) in a scroll-snap carousel with prev/next arrows; 2/3/5 tiles visible on mobile/tablet/desktop. Each tile is a single link.
contentPattern: One row per tile. Cell 1: icon (:icon-name: or SVG image). Cell 2: label as linked text.
usage: Home page quick links strip (Desinvestimento da UEGA, Eficiencia energetica, Direitos do consumidor, Canal de denuncias, Geracao distribuida, Rede eletrica inteligente, Atendimento, Venda de imoveis, Consulta previa).
reuseGuidance: Use for a scrollable strip of icon shortcuts. Arrows hide automatically when all tiles fit. Tiles without a link render as plain (non-clickable) tiles.
